Read the page, not the popups

A Safari extension • by Luna

Stop popups and blocking ads, automatically. Unblock and save most of the web, without leaving Safari. When you want the full Luna experience, it's one tap away. Don't worry. All your data is offline. There are no Luna servers to send anything to. All Luna apps' features are bundled in this one.

Turn it on in Safari

  1. Tap the page menu in the address bar
  2. Choose “Manage Extensions”
  3. Switch on Luna
